tools.name: token_safety_composite
tools.description: Safety score for an EVM or Solana token: contract/mint authority checks, holder concentration, on-chain liquidity depth, pool age and trade-flow flags. Use when you need to screen a token or mint address before interacting with it: contract or mint authority, holder concentration, liquidity depth, p

tools.name: wallet_portfolio_composite
tools.description: USD portfolio for an EVM or Solana wallet: native balance, major token balances, prices and allocation

tools.name: solana_mint_auditor
tools.description: Audit a Solana SPL mint: mint/freeze authority, supply, decimals, Token-2022 extensions and top-holder concentration

tools.name: base_erc20_inspector
tools.description: Inspect an ERC-20 on Base or another EVM chain: name, symbol, decimals, supply, owner, proxy slot and risky function selectors

tools.name: dex_liquidity_depth
tools.description: On-chain liquidity pools for a token with liquidity, volume, and estimated price impact for $100 to $100k trades

tools.name: stablecoin_depeg_monitor
tools.description: Peg deviation in basis points for major stablecoins from independent market data feeds

tools.name: gas_fee_estimator
tools.description: Live gas price and USD cost estimates for transfers, ERC-20 transfers and token-trade contract calls on EVM chains

tools.name: tx_hash_decoder
tools.description: Decode an EVM transaction: status, fee, method selector, ERC-20 transfers and approvals

tools.name: address_checksum_validator
tools.description: Validate an EVM address (EIP-55 checksum) or Solana address (base58, 32 bytes) and return the canonical form

tools.name: token_price_aggregator
tools.description: Median USD price for a ticker across Coinbase, Kraken and Bitstamp with spread, plus on-chain pool price when a contract address is supplied

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "token_safety_composite" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
